facts.fact: 第一个真正的吻、开始接受商业课
facts.anchor: My first real kiss with Harrison outshone my misgivings about becoming a Greer

facts.fact: 冒充 Joe 妻子向医院确认
facts.anchor: which Gazzie made me, posing as Joe’s wife, confirm with the hospital

facts.fact: 订黄色太阳裙备约会
facts.anchor: I ordered a yellow sundress for the occasion

facts.fact: 电台预告下周末可能有热带风暴
facts.anchor: the radio announced the possibility of a tropical storm the following weekend

facts.fact: Gazzie 静听电话、哼两声挂断
facts.anchor: Gazzie listened in silence, grunted twice, and said goodbye

facts.fact: 四分钟内出发
facts.anchor: she yelled

facts.fact: 倒车冲出停车场
facts.anchor: She threw it into reverse before I’d buckled myself in, whipping us out of the parking lot

facts.fact: Harrison 称巡周边时见办公室亮灯
facts.anchor: I saw a light on in the office

facts.fact: 报告现场有血
facts.anchor: “Blood,” he replied.

facts.fact: 递水瓶、Gazzie 眯眼
facts.anchor: I handed him my water bottle. As he tipped it to his lips, Gazzie narrowed her eyes.

facts.fact: Gazzie 推开 Harrison 进办公楼
facts.anchor: She pushed past Harrison and through the front doors.

facts.fact: Harrison 抓臂让她转身面对
facts.anchor: he caught me by the arm, gently pulling me to face him

facts.fact: 血中滑倒摔伤前臂
facts.anchor: I slipped, flying through the air and landing on my forearm with a crack

facts.fact: Gazzie 斥「你真丢人」
facts.anchor: You’re embarrassing yourself

facts.fact: 搂腰扶稳至眼前黑点散去
facts.anchor: She pulled me up, holding me around the waist until the black spots in my vision dissipated

facts.fact: 录像凌晨两点缺一小时、被删
facts.anchor: Security company says someone deleted the recording

facts.fact: 疑员工或前员工渗透监控公司
facts.anchor: Maybe one of our employees or ex-employees has an in with the surveillance company?

facts.fact: Joe 在圣彼得堡医院；问 Nova
facts.anchor: Joe’s at the hospital in St. Petersburg

facts.fact: Nova 带行李箱离开、房子已空
facts.anchor: Friend on the force said she left with a bunch of suitcases. House is empty.

facts.fact: 命 Harrison 叫清洁工并全天跟进
facts.anchor: call the cleaners

facts.fact: 命两人留宿农场通宵
facts.anchor: Then you two will stay the night.

facts.fact: Harrison 拉手腕到雨中冲血
facts.anchor: Taking my wrists between his fingers, Harrison pulled my arms out from under the awning’s protection
